broker.name: Weltrade
broker.tagline: On its own site since 2006. Its site names FSCA. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:10000.
broker.about: Weltrade says it has operated since 2006. The pages checked do not name one headquarters. Account names on its site include Micro, Pro, SyntX, Raw Spread, and Cent. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, WebTrader, and Weltrade app. The site names these regulators: FSCA. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:10000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FSCA: Weltrade SA (Pty) Ltd, 50691.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: Global homepage starting deposits: Micro, SyntX, Raw Spread and Cent 1 USD, Pro 10 USD. Help Center, 30 June 2026, says every deposit is subject to a $10 payment-system minimum, and lists Micro, Cent and SyntX at $1, Pro at $10, and Raw Spread at 100 USD (deposit not required immediately to open). New Micro accounts are no longer available. Not one number.

other_fees.label: Deposit minimum from payment systems
other_fees.note: Help Center says this applies to all deposits regardless of account type.

other_fees.note: Help Center. Per-side or round-turn is not specified.

_notes.fetch_notes: Global homepage and company page fetched. Company history starts with SystemForex in June 2006 and a rebrand to Weltrade in March 2012. Page says trusted trading since 2006. No single headquarters. Offices are mentioned over time in Minsk, Kyiv, Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam, Kazakhstan, Laos, Cambodia and the Philippines, without calling one the head office. ZA company and legal pages fetched. FSCA licence is an intermediary licence for Weltrade SA, not a licence for Weltrade Ltd. A Help Center article says Weltrade Ltd is regulated by the laws of Saint Lucia and refers to an official licence without naming the authority or a licence number, so no Saint Lucia regulator is listed. Global FAQ also names a Premium account in the bonus codes. Premium conditions were not on the fetched account cards.
_notes.company_details_not_listed: Global company page: Weltrade Ltd, incorporated in Saint Lucia, registration 2023-00055, operating under the laws of Saint Lucia. No Saint Lucia financial regulator or licence number is named there. South Africa company page: Weltrade SA (Pty) Ltd, registration 2019/334947/07, 46 Fairmount Avenue, Fairmount, Johannesburg, Gauteng, 2192. ZA legal page: Category I intermediary under FAIS, FSP 50691. It does not issue products or act as counterparty. CFD services are provided by product supplier Weltrade Ltd.
